data.short_description: Sal e Brasa is opening its third Texas location in the Uptown Houston/Galleria area. Construction is planned to start in September and wrap in late November, pending a $1.2 million build-out. A "coming soon" sign is already posted at the site.

Hamra Enterprises is reopening seven Panera Bread locations across the Greater Houston area, beginning with a Spring location on July 16. The Houston-area restaurants had been closed since August 2025 following a franchise dispute and bankruptcy filing by the previous owner. The Spring opening marks Hamra's first Texas location and entry into its 12th state.

Hamra Enterprises is reopening seven Panera Bread locations across the Greater Houston area, with the Katy location planned after the Spring opening. The Houston-area restaurants had been closed since August 2025 following a franchise dispute and bankruptcy filing by the previous owner.

A new unnamed restaurant and bar is planned for the former Clarke's at Faneuil Hall space in downtown Boston. MerchRow LLC, led by restaurateur John Jacob, has petitioned to transfer the liquor license and plans a similar dining concept with two rooms, a central bar, and a seasonal patio. An official name is still being finalized.

204 Washington Tavern is taking over the former 204 Washington Restaurant & Bar space in East Walpole. Commercial remodeling permits were filed in early June 2026, and the new concept will feature a remodeled interior with custom seating, accommodating up to 120 guests. An official opening timeline has not yet been released.

The restaurant will offer a fine dining seafood experience with waterfront views, a lively oyster bar, and indoor-outdoor spaces. Owner Mowbray Rowand describes the menu as centered on premium seafood with a Southern influence.

data.status: opening date has not yet been announced

The restaurant is known for customizable seafood boils, Cajun-inspired favorites, and a casual dining atmosphere. The restaurant has announced it is actively hiring for all positions ahead of its opening.

data.status: construction expected to wrap by the end of the year
data.short_description: Snarf's Sandwiches is planning a new location at 2005 Fort Worth Avenue in Dallas's Kessler Park neighborhood. Construction is expected to wrap by the end of the year, with no confirmed opening date yet. This adds to a wave of North Texas openings for the chain, including planned locations in Campbell Road, Lakewood, and Irving.

Construction is expected to wrap by the end of the year, with no confirmed opening date shared. The location is part of TexBrew's ongoing rollout of Tim Hortons locations across the Austin metro.

Acropolis of Mandeville has rebranded as Compagno's under new owner Michael Compagno, reviving a family restaurant tradition dating back to 1929. The menu honors the family's culinary heritage with Italian favorites and several of the owner's grandmother's original recipes. Refreshed branding, updated décor, and a renewed dining experience accompany the transformation.

Owner Matt Van Sistine plans to revive the historic Western Hotel name and introduce separate restaurant and entertainment concepts within the development. Plans are being submitted this week, with construction expected to begin within two to three months.

Owner Aziz confirmed the new spot is targeting a September opening, pending inspections, and will feature a more luxurious interior. The menu will carry the same specialty coffee offerings that have made the original location popular.

La Casita Bakeshop is relocating from its original downtown Rowlett location, which can only fit four or five people, to a larger space nearby. The original location is being vacated as part of this move.

The new space will expand its offerings beyond a coffee shop format to include brunch and lunch service, with dinner potentially on the horizon. Co-owner Alex Henderson says the move is intended to better serve the community with more seating and a fuller dining experience.

data.status: opening date is looking like Aug. 5 or later
data.short_description: Tonto's Coney World is a new coney island concept by Kalamazoo local Mike "Tonto" Alexander, set to open this summer at 3621 Stadium Drive near Western Michigan University. The menu features Detroit-style coney dogs with chili, mustard, and onions, as well as chili bowls. Alexander is promoting the opening by distributing printed business cards for one free coney dog.

data.location: 363 Green Valley Rd, El Dorado Hills, CA 95762

The menu is also being refreshed as part of the renovation. No official completion date has been announced.

Pulido's Kitchen and Cantina is permanently closing its Hurst location on July 16. The team cited the decision was made after much thought but did not share an official reason for the closure. Remaining locations in Willow Park and Eastland, Texas will continue to operate.

data.status: work is underway to bring the concept to Pacific Beach by Labor Day Weekend

Franchise owner Greg Nazloo plans a grand opening celebration with 1,000 free burgers and fries. A second San Diego location is also planned for Rolando Village under separate franchise ownership.

data.status: anticipated to open its second location in Henderson sometime this year
data.short_description: Grill Nine is working on a second Henderson location, though the exact address and timeline have not been confirmed. The Korean BBQ restaurant currently operates two locations in the Las Vegas Valley. This is a developing story with limited details available.

Colectivo Coffee is planning a new café in Roscoe Village at 2032 W Roscoe Street, with an opening expected sometime in fall 2026. This follows the company's recent opening at 3258 N Southport Avenue in Lakeview. Colectivo currently operates six cafés in Chicago, 12 in Milwaukee, and locations in Madison.

data.location: 415 E St Elmo Rd, Austin, TX 78745

data.short_description: C.L. Butaud is permanently closing its South Austin tasting room on July 26 due to rising rent costs and financial strain. The winery will continue operating online through its store and wine club while actively searching for a new Austin location. The tasting room had been established in 2024.

Everdine's Grilled Cheese Co. is closing its Naperville location permanently on July 17 after nearly a decade in business. The family-owned sandwich restaurant specializes in gourmet grilled cheese sandwiches and opened in 2016. The Batavia location will remain open.

FNF Hot Burger is expanding to Phipps Plaza food hall on the first floor, with a grand opening planned for later this summer. The brand is awaiting final permitting, which will determine the exact opening date. FNF Hot Burger launched in Decatur in early 2025 and later opened at Halidom Eatery in East Atlanta.

Cellar Hand, a wine-focused restaurant in Hillcrest, announced it will close on July 19 after a two-year run. The restaurant was recognized by Wine Enthusiast as one of the Top 50 New Restaurants in 2025. Pali Wine Co.'s tasting room will relocate to the former Cellar Hand space following the closure.

data.location: Address not specified (seeking space in downtown Geneva, IL; currently operating at 1107 Maple Avenue, Lisle, IL)
data.short_description: The owner of Astoria Cafe and Bakery is seeking a brick-and-mortar space in downtown Geneva, Illinois, while currently operating out of a ghost kitchen in Lisle. No set location or opening date has been announced yet. The cafe specializes in Balkan cuisine and European-style desserts.

Harlem Shake, an award-winning burger and shake concept, is set to debut at 1330 Walnut St. in Philadelphia, marking the brand's first franchise location and first outpost outside New York. No opening date has been announced. The menu will feature custom-blend burgers, hot dogs, chicken sandwiches, and handmade shakes.

data.event_date: Early fall, around Labor Day weekend
data.short_description: Bloom, a European-inspired patisserie and neighborhood cafe, is currently under construction inside Highside Market in Columbus, Georgia. The owner plans to open around Labor Day weekend, offering French and Italian pastries, wines, champagnes, and light lunch items. The concept is inspired by the European "cakes and bubbles" experience.

Frenchette Bakery opened its third location on July 14 at 370 Broome Street in Nolita, offering breads, pastries, sandwiches, and an expanded menu including its first bacon, egg, and cheese sandwich. The new location features a refrigerated pastry case with cream-filled desserts not available at the original bakery. The bakery is operated by restaurateurs Lee Hanson and Riad Nasr.

The Bagelry is expanding with a third Cincinnati-area location at 11013 Montgomery Road in Montgomery, with construction progressing and a targeted early fall opening. The approximately 3,000-square-foot space will be the company's largest location to date, featuring a larger dining area and more organized queue. The menu will remain the same as at the existing Over-the-Rhine and Oakley locations.

Chickadee, a Mediterranean restaurant in Boston's Seaport District, announced it will close after eight years of service, with July 18 as its final day. The restaurant is owned by New England-based chef John daSilva and was a James Beard Foundation Awards semifinalist in 2025. The team did not provide a reason for the closure.

Shook Shakery, a new milkshake chain, is slated to debut its first of four Southern Nevada locations at 3360 St Rose Parkway in Henderson. The concept offers $9 shakes in 15 flavors across three categories, with milkshake mixed with cake as the signature offering. A partner of the brand is a co-founder of Nothing Bundt Cakes.

data.store_name: Tupelo Coffee (1500 Q St – rebranding from Naked Coffee)

data.short_description: The last remaining Naked Coffee location at 1500 Q St in Midtown Sacramento has been acquired by new owner Vitaliy Vinnichuk and is being rebranded as Tupelo Coffee, closing out the Naked Coffee brand. The transition occurred approximately two months before publication. New housemade syrups and specialty drinks are being added to the menu.

data.store_name: Tupelo Coffee (5700 Elvas Ave – ownership change)
data.short_description: The ownership transfer of Tupelo Coffee's existing Elvas Ave location does not qualify as a new opening or closure event.

Char, a new Vietnamese grill-focused dining concept from Mamba Hospitality Group, is planned to open at 11215 Bellaire Blvd alongside sister concept Ocean Palace in Spring 2027. The restaurant will feature premium grilled meats, fresh ingredients, and interactive tabletop dining inspired by the traditional Bò 7 Món experience. Char will have its own dedicated space and entrance facing Bellaire Blvd.

Pho Prime is planned to open a new location within Stomping Grounds in Garden Oaks at 1223 W 34th St, with a grand opening targeted for October 3, 2026, pending final permit approvals and construction. The modern Vietnamese restaurant is operated by Mamba Hospitality Group and is the brand's third Houston-area location. The new space was previously occupied by Pho Fix, which closed in January.

Kitchens for Good, a San Diego nonprofit, is planning a public-facing Market Café as part of its new 29,000-square-foot Culinary Impact Center in Bankers Hill, expected to open in mid-2027. The café will allow culinary apprentices to prepare and serve food while earning wages. The nonprofit recently received a $50,000 grant to support the Market Café.

Scaddabush Italian Kitchen & Bar is set to open a new location at 28 First Commerce Drive in Aurora, moving into the former Swiss Chalet space that closed in February. Renovations are underway and a banner at the site announces the restaurant is "opening soon," with an exact opening date yet to be announced. The brand is part of SIR Corp., a Canadian restaurant company.

Scaddabush Italian Kitchen & Bar is scheduled to open a new location at 625 Kanata Avenue in Kanata on August 1, 2026. The restaurant is also under development as part of the brand's growing presence in Ontario. Customers can expect the brand's scratch-made pastas, pizzas, and fresh mozzarella.

Pali Wine Co. will close its Little Italy tasting room at 2130 India Street on July 19, 2026, as part of its relocation to Hillcrest. The move was driven by the landlord seeking to nearly double the rent at the Little Italy location. The Perr family has maintained a presence in the San Diego market for about a decade.

The new location will offer the same wine selection, wine club benefits, private tastings, and a food menu similar to those offered in Little Italy. Executive chef Sable Tanya Wentwoord is expected to continue leading the food program.

St. Louis Bar & Grill is planning a new location in the Niagara region of Ontario, listed among its future franchise locations on the company's website with an anticipated opening in 2027. No exact address or opening date has been announced. The brand operates more than 80 locations across Canada.

A grand opening is planned and marketing for the location is already underway.

Clubhouse 56, an East Sacramento sports bar and restaurant, is expanding to a second location inside WildHawk Golf Club at 7713 Vineyard Road in south Sacramento, with a planned reopening in mid-August. Co-owner Lisa Petersen-Scoto confirmed the team is taking over the clubhouse restaurant from the previous operator. A liquor license filed under Clubhouse 56 @ WildHawk by TLC Legacy LLC with the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control confirms the transition is underway.

Pizza franchise Slice House by Tony Gemignani has a new location planned at 2390 Las Posas Rd in Camarillo, according to a social media post from the local franchisee. The franchise, which has 150 units either open or in development, is known for various pizza styles including New York, Sicilian, Grandma, and Detroit-style pizzas.

data.short_description: Two Sisters and A Deviled Crab closed its brick-and-mortar location inside the Orange Park Mall food court on July 11 after three years of operation. The owners plan to return to food truck operations to continue serving customers in Jacksonville.

Redeye Grill, a Midtown Manhattan brasserie known for seafood, steaks, and brasserie-style dining, closed after its final dinner service on July 12 after 30 years in business. The restaurant was part of the Fireman Hospitality Group portfolio; no reason for the closure was provided.

Rise Baking Company is relocating its Innovation Center from Tucker to a new Commercial and Customer Center of Excellence at 575 Main Street NE in Uptown Atlanta, following the expiration of its current lease. The new facility will encompass more than 30,000 square feet of office and R&D space, bringing together Atlanta-based teams.

Jim and Patty's Coffee closed its doors at 4951 NE Fremont Street in Northeast Portland on Sunday, July 12. New owner Paul Ceserani confirmed transition plans are still being worked out, with Spielman Bagels and Coffee as one option being considered for the space. A handful of Jim and Patty's signature menu items will continue to be available at Spielman locations during the transition.

Fizz N Sip, a North Portland dirty soda shop, is expanding to Milwaukie with a second location at 10909 SE Main Street inside the historic Perry's Pharmacy Building. Owner Veronika Sakhashchik plans to add Milwaukie-inspired drinks and partner with local businesses for ice cream. The concept allows customers to customize soda bases with flavored syrups, coconut cream, marshmallow fluff, and fruit purees.

Dos Carnales is relocating from its current location at 10840 Harry Hines Blvd to a new spot a few doors down within the Grand Bazaar development. The owner did not respond to comment by press time. The move keeps the restaurant within the same Harry Hines corridor.

The brand currently operates two Las Vegas Valley locations, one on West Lake Mead and another on West Tropicana.

This is one of two Campus Burgers locations planned for San Diego as the brand expands into Southern California.

Sushi Sakana is also opening a Frisco location at 3245 Main St, expected to open in September 2026. Co-owner James Park shared the details with What Now Dallas. The Frisco location is part of the brand's growth push into newer, fast-growing communities in North Texas.

Edna's Pizzeria is coming to 10933 SE Main Street in downtown Milwaukie, with owner Joram Young confirming an October opening. The new pizza parlor will take over a suite vacated by Pietro's Pizza, which left its longtime SE Main Street location in June 2025. Young previously operated Town, a by-the-slice joint in Los Angeles, before relocating to the Pacific Northwest.

Amaru Nightclub is set to open in November at 1864 E. Mariposa Road in Stockton, taking over a space most recently occupied by El Centenario Club. Owner Johnny Ene confirmed the opening, with a pending liquor license filed with the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control confirming the project is moving forward. Concept details have not yet been disclosed.

data.status: An opening date has not yet been announced

An opening date has not yet been announced, and the new location will likely replace the brand's current Robo Shop vending machine at the mall. Pop Mart is a China-based designer toy retailer known for its blind box collectibles.

The pub will feature beers on tap, whiskeys, prepared cocktails, and expected food items like fish and chips and a traditional Irish breakfast.

Sana'a Cafe, a Yemeni coffee shop based in San Francisco, is targeting multiple areas of Los Angeles County for expansion, including a location at 1302 Pico Blvd in Santa Monica currently under construction with a targeted opening between late August and mid-September. The brand also plans locations in Long Beach, along Wilshire Boulevard, and in Orange County. The Westwood location is expected to unveil by end of July 2026.

Adega Gaucha Brazilian Steakhouse is planning its first location outside of Florida, taking over the former Iron Hill Brewing space in Dunwoody's Twelve24 development at 1224 Hammond Dr. Co-founder and COO Fabiano Borsato told What Now Atlanta they are targeting a January 2027 opening. The approximately 8,000 square-foot restaurant will seat more than 250 customers across the dining room, bar, and patio.

Call Your Mother, a D.C.-based bagel shop and Jewish deli, is set to open on the ground floor of the Jessup House at 1134 Sansom St. in Philadelphia. The shop will mark the brand's third Philadelphia outpost, joining locations under construction in Fishtown and Rittenhouse Square. No opening date has been specified in the article.

Cactus Taqueria, a Hollywood taco stand founded in 1992, permanently closed on July 12 after 34 years in business. The closure was due to the sale of the Vine Street property to Angel Project Foundation. The family-run business currently operates five other locations across Los Angeles.

Ella Coffeehouse will open its first franchised location in Boynton Beach, Florida on July 18, 2026. The South Florida-based coffee brand, founded in 2016, previously operated locations in Coral Springs, Davie, and Plantation. Grand opening festivities include complimentary coffee for the first 100 guests and a free mug for the first 50 visitors.

data.short_description: El Veganito, a vegan Mexican restaurant inside Grossmont Center's food court, will close on August 26 after six years in business. The owner announced the closure after being asked to vacate the building amid the shopping center's multi-phase redevelopment plans. The team is actively searching for a new location to continue operating.

Rei do Gado, a Brazilian steakhouse that has served downtown San Diego since 1999, will reopen on July 20 after being closed for nearly two years following a July 2024 fire that damaged its four-story building. The restaurant has undergone a full renovation with a redesigned interior. Dinner service will be available daily from 4–10 p.m., with lunch served Friday through Sunday starting at 11 a.m.
